headline: Discussion of claims.
summary: The meeting will discuss claims. Back-up documentation is linked in the meeting notice.
location: City Council Chambers, 93 Washington St., Salem, MA, 2nd Floor

City of Salem, Massachusetts 
Office of the City Clerk

October 28, 2026 
 
 
MEETING NOTICE AND AGENDA 
 
The City Council Committee on Ordinances, Licenses and Legal Affairs co-posted with 
the Committee of the Whole will meet in person on Tuesday November 17, 2026, at 6:00 
PM for the purpose of discussing Claims.  This meeting will be held in the City Council 
Chambers. 93 Washington St., Salem, MA, 2nd Floor.
